# Kettle cart, phase 2: form (generated by make_cart.py): the band, the lid, the chimney cap, the slats,
# the hub caps; hidden faces deleted; flat shading; the export.
add mesh cylinder --name Band --vertices 8 --radius 0.3485 --depth 0.0700 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set location 0.0000 -0.5800 0.7650
apply --location
material assign Cream
add mesh cone --name Lid --vertices 8 --radius1 0.3301 --radius2 0.2165 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set location 0 -0.58 0.985
apply --location
material assign Slate
add mesh cone --name Flare --vertices 8 --radius1 0.0920 --radius2 0.1515 --depth 0.07 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set location 0 -0.58 1.295
apply --location
material assign Slate
add mesh cylinder --name Cap --vertices 8 --radius 0.1515 --depth 0.0300 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set location 0.0000 -0.5800 1.3450
apply --location
material assign Slate
add mesh cube --name Slat0 --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.4800 0.6500
scale 0.6800 0.7200 0.0750
apply --scale
material assign Slat
add mesh cube --name Slat1 --size 1 --location 0.0000 0.4800 0.8400
scale 0.6800 0.7200 0.0750
apply --scale
material assign Slat
add mesh cylinder --name HubFL --vertices 8 --radius 0.0812 --depth 0.0400 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
set location -0.5010 -0.6200 0.2280
apply --location
material assign Cream
add mesh cylinder --name HubFR --vertices 8 --radius 0.0812 --depth 0.0400 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.5010 -0.6200 0.2280
apply --location
material assign Cream
add mesh cylinder --name HubRL --vertices 8 --radius 0.0812 --depth 0.0400 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
set location -0.5010 0.6200 0.2280
apply --location
material assign Cream
add mesh cylinder --name HubRR --vertices 8 --radius 0.0812 --depth 0.0400 --location 0 0 0
set rotation 0 0 22.5
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 90 0
apply --rotation
set location 0.5010 0.6200 0.2280
apply --location
material assign Cream
select Stack
active Stack
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
select Boiler
active Boiler
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
select Crate
active Crate
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.5"
delete face
mode object
select all
shade flat
export cart.glb
